stories.title: Lincoln City's Dramatic Win at Bolton
stories.details: Lincoln City secured a 1-0 victory against Bolton Wanderers in the Championship, described as a 'daylight robbery' by the author. Ben House scored the decisive goal, while goalkeeper George Wickens and defender Ryley Towler were instrumental in holding off Bolton's late pressure.

stories.title: West Ham vs Wolves Preview
stories.details: West Ham manager Nuno Espirito Santo faces his former club, Wolves, in a high-stakes early-season fixture. Both teams are looking to improve their standing after a challenging start to the campaign.

stories.title: Ipswich vs Liverpool Preview
stories.details: Liverpool faces Ipswich in an intriguing Friday night clash. Liverpool is looking to find form after two opening draws, while Ipswich aims to bounce back from a heavy 5-2 defeat to Manchester United.

stories.title: Arsenal vs Chelsea Preview
stories.details: The upcoming Sunday match features the champions, Arsenal, against Chelsea. The game highlights tactical battles between managers Arteta and Alonso, and features key players like Palmer and Gabriel.

stories.title: Saka Settles Arsenal Victory
stories.details: Bukayo Saka scored the decisive goal in a gruelling battle against Aston Villa, extending Arsenal's winning start to the Premier League season.

stories.title: BBC Cancels Women's Football Highlights
stories.details: The BBC has cancelled its flagship women's football highlights show, though the broadcaster maintains it remains 'fully committed' to the sport.

stories.title: Lionel Messi Retires from International Football
stories.details: Argentinian legend Lionel Messi has announced his retirement from international football. The 2022 World Cup winner confirmed the news in an emotional social media statement.

stories.title: Novak Djokovic Out of US Open
stories.details: Novak Djokovic suffered a first-round exit at the US Open, his earliest major defeat since 2006. The tennis star attributed the loss to ongoing injury and illness.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Returns to US Open
stories.details: Carlos Alcaraz made a successful return to the US Open after a four-month absence. The 'pain-free' player brushed aside his qualifier opponent in a dominant performance.

stories.title: Kobe McDonald to Chase County Title
stories.details: Kobe McDonald has received clearance from St Kilda to return to Ireland and compete for the county title with his club, Crossmolina.

stories.title: Global Bond Sell-off and Rising Oil Prices
stories.details: Global bond yields have hit new highs as oil prices climbed above $91 a barrel, stoking inflation fears. The sell-off is affecting markets in the US, UK, and Japan, with investors pricing in potential interest rate hikes.

stories.title: Trump Announces 50% Tariff on Canadian Goods
stories.details: Donald Trump has announced a new 50% tariff on Canadian cars, trucks, and steel. The move is expected to have significant implications for North American trade relations.

stories.title: UK Inflation and Energy Costs
stories.details: Price rises are gathering pace in UK shops, driven by higher energy costs. Households in Great Britain are warned they could owe energy suppliers £7bn by the end of the year.

stories.title: Shein Stock Market Debut
stories.details: Shares of fast-fashion retailer Shein slid during its stock market debut. The company faces ongoing scrutiny regarding its business model and market performance.

stories.title: BT Windfall from Copper Sale
stories.details: BT is on track for an estimated £2bn windfall from selling its old copper infrastructure. The sale comes amid a broader industry shift driven by the AI boom.

stories.title: Andy Burnham on UK Economic Growth
stories.details: Andy Burnham has told MPs that more public control is the only way to grow the UK economy. The government is also tracking his plan to implement a trade ban on Israeli settlements.

stories.title: John Healey's Defence Spending Commitments
stories.details: Chancellor John Healey has vowed that defence will be central to his spending plans. He faces pressure to meet Nato spending targets while managing a £5bn funding hole in the upcoming budget.

stories.title: Tory Party Reshuffle
stories.details: Kemi Badenoch has reshuffled her top team and put the Conservative Party on a 'war footing' in anticipation of a potential early general election.

stories.title: Water Supply Risk Upgrade
stories.details: Government officials have significantly upgraded the risk of a catastrophic loss of water supply for one million people. Water companies are also facing scrutiny over sewage discharges.

stories.title: Child Trust Fund Review
stories.details: Firms managing child trust funds face a government review regarding their efforts to identify the owners of £1.5bn worth of dormant accounts.

stories.title: Tim Cook Steps Down as Apple CEO
stories.details: Tim Cook has officially stepped down as Apple CEO, with hardware chief John Ternus taking over the role. Cook will remain at Apple in a new capacity.

stories.title: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ad Revenue
stories.details: OpenAI's advertising business within ChatGPT has reached a $1 billion annual run rate. The company has also opened self-serve ad access across 31 European markets.

stories.title: Music Labels Sue Anthropic
stories.details: Sony Music and Warner Music have filed a lawsuit against Anthropic, accusing the AI company of pirating copyrighted songs to train its Claude models.

stories.title: AI Labs Buying Mac Minis
stories.details: AI companies, including OpenAI, have purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to train computer-use agents, causing supply shortages.

stories.title: EU Classifies ChatGPT as Search Engine
stories.details: The European Commission has classified ChatGPT as a 'Very Large Online Search Engine' under the Digital Services Act, subjecting it to stricter oversight and audit requirements.

stories.title: Amazon Surcharge Lawsuit
stories.details: The US trade regulator and 22 states have accused Amazon of inflating ad prices and taking $20bn through secret surcharges.

stories.title: Duane Keith Davis Convicted for Tupac Shakur Murder
stories.details: A Las Vegas jury has found Duane Keith Davis guilty of the 1996 murder of US rap legend Tupac Shakur, bringing closure to a 30-year-old case.

stories.title: US-Iran Conflict Flare-up
stories.details: The US and Iran have exchanged fire for the first time in a month. President Trump has threatened further action following attacks on US military bases in Jordan and the UAE.

stories.title: Principal Saves 900 Students in Nepal
stories.details: A school principal in Nepal, Rajendra Dawadi, successfully evacuated 900 students before a major flood destroyed their school. The country is now seeking $5 billion in climate disaster aid.
